candidates.hook: Police Constable: “Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.”
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine’s desperate cry “I was supposed to be your Duchess!” cuts just before Alexander’s cold reply “You were never my Duchess.”
candidates.why: Immediate authority threat grabs attention, then a heartbreaking plea leaves viewers hanging on his brutal rejection.

candidates.hook: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing Catherine’s touch.
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander’s skeptical question “Did you?” leaves the audience wondering if her love was real.
candidates.why: A visual snub creates instant drama, and the lingering doubt compels viewers to watch the resolution.

candidates.hook: Catherine (Desperate, Demanding): “I was supposed to be your Duchess!”
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine gasps “Her?!” as Alexander walks toward the chained Juliana, leaving the identity of his chosen bride unknown.
candidates.why: A raw demand followed by a shocking reveal of a new bride creates a powerful emotional hook and a cliffhanger.

moments.desc: Police Constable declares the arrest – a clear threat that stops scrolling.
Catherine gathers her train and walks toward Alexander, setting up her plea.
Alexander’s cold line “You were never my Duchess.” can be used as a payoff in another edit.
Alexander turns and walks toward the chained Juliana – a shocking new bride reveal.
